text.en: This Order may be cited as the Customs (Amendment) Order, 2000 · Amendment of se 冚 0 117 of Chapter 36 ·

Section 117 of the Customs Act is amended by deleting "shall" fr om the third an d fifth lines and by substituting "may" therefor. Made this 18th. day of Rejab, 1421 Hijriah corresponding to the 16th. day of October, 2000 at Our lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan , Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUS SALAM 2155
